name: @kanzo-tech/docs
description: Kanzo UI documentation — Next.js App Router + fumadocs, mirroring Shark UI's docs stack. Doubles as the RSC fixture: Vite ignores "use client", so this is the only place the library's client/server boundary is actually exercised.

scripts.//build:static: What GitHub Pages gets: `output: "export"` plus the project-page prefix, then the post-build pass that puts the `.mdx` source files back at the URLs the rewrite used to serve. Separate from `build` because `output: "export"` removes `next start`, and `check:previews` drives a running server. Override NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH and NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL to serve it from anywhere else; the site URL is what `llms.txt` advertises, and a static export cannot read it from request headers.
scripts.//corpus: The workspace archive the showcase and the graph pages open, written by fossil's writer (`@fossil-lang/executor`) into `public/corpus/archive`, which is gitignored. `build:static` runs it first, because the export serves what `public/` holds and a corpus that was never written is a 404 on the published site.
scripts.build:static: pnpm run corpus && DOCS_STATIC_EXPORT=1 NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH="${NEXT_PUBLIC_BASE_PATH-/ui}" NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL="${NEXT_PUBLIC_SITE_URL-https://kanzo-tech.github.io/ui}" next build --webpack && node scripts/materialise-mdx.mjs

//fossil: `@fossil-lang/corpus` is the docs' own dependency, not the graph's: the pages attach each corpus with its `open` on the page's `engine()` and name the catalog to `GraphRoot`. `@fossil-lang/executor` is the writer, a dev dependency: `corpus` and the benchmark's `build-corpus.mjs` run it in Node, and nothing on a page imports it.
//deps: @kanzo-tech/{ui,theme,graph,ai,llm,auth,navigation} are workspace deps. `ai` and `@ai-sdk/react` are @kanzo-tech/ai's required peers, installed once here as a host would; the examples and showcases build their models with `ai/test`'s mock, so nothing on the site calls a provider. There is no colour-derivation package any more: a theme is a flat CSS file that ships with @kanzo-tech/theme.
